provenance.method: Stand-in: hover thrust = AUW / motors; motor power interpolated from the maker's thrust table at that thrust; plus avionics.
assumptions: motor figures interpolate linearly between the 10 rows of the maker's table (0 at 0 % throttle); pack current = table electrical power ÷ 22.2 V nominal
maker's table used the MEPS SZ4942 prop at 25.2 V, not the fitted propeller
avionics: DJI O4 minimum supply power 10 W, GNSS 50 mA at 5 V, FC + receiver 2.5 W (assumed), BEC efficiency 85 % (assumed)

all-up weight = 587.2 g from systemMass (derived:mass.all_up, of which 154.4 g is CAD volume × assumed material) + 20 g assumed for the 17 parts with no mass in the model (FC/ESC SH1.0 8-pin cable, Panasonic EEU-FR1V471 470 µF 35 V low-ESR electrolytic capacitor, XT60 battery lead (12 AWG), DJI O4 3-in-1 cable, GNSS lead (GH6P, FC end soldered), Receiver wires (RP1 V2 CRSF wire), Bulk capacitor leads, Motor 2 phase leads (Front-right), Motor 1 phase leads (Rear-right), Motor 3 phase leads (Rear-left), Motor 4 phase leads (Front-left), Flux-cored solder wire, 0.8 mm, No-clean flux (pen or paste), Threadlocker, medium strength (blue), Clear heat-shrink sleeve for the receiver, about 15 mm flat width, Double-sided foam mounting tape, 1 mm, Cable ties, 2.5 mm x 100 mm)
